user_request: 의도는 이해되지만 더 세련된 표현. 노란 네모와 분홍 화소의 의미를 구분해야 함.
yellow_rectangle: Display crop only; does not label the entire area as textureless or missing depth.
pink_pixels: Actual missing depth locations with known reference support; not an absence of pink pixels.
roof: 20 evaluated depth pixels, all missing; only 4 have reference support and are painted. Use neutral heading 지붕의 평가 구간.
uncoloured: Includes unevaluated and reference-unknown locations; must not be read as all correct.
style: Lighter text labels and leaders, thinner crop frames, quieter typography; retain R4 source crops and evidence.
